headline: AI rebound faded as Tuesday split the twelve tracked names

gauge.text: All twelve tracked names finished higher in the completed Tuesday session.

macro.dd: AP reported the Nasdaq composite rose 6.5% on Tuesday as beaten-down AI stocks rallied. The move followed Friday’s correction and is market context, not proof of a company-specific cause for any one bar.

readthrough.heading: Cross-company interpretation
readthrough.title: A rebound is evidence of positioning before it is evidence of earnings
readthrough.body: The twelve validated completed bars were all positive, with especially large gains in Tesla, Palantir, Nebius, Marvell and Nvidia. Tuesday’s AI-led rebound and Tuesday rotation was associated with Nvidia leadership news and a broad risk reversal, but a correlated price move cannot prove causation for each company. The next guidance, demand, financing and cash-flow disclosures should test whether expectations changed durably.
